(1) COVERAGE INCREASE, NOT A REGRESSION (the bulk of the +10). orm/_typing.py exported nothing named CommandValue or Registry, yet orm/fields/relational/{_base,one2many,many2many}.py each did 'from ..._typing import CommandValue, Registry' under TYPE_CHECKING (CommandValue lives in orm/primitives.py, Registry in orm/runtime/registry.py). mypy resolves an unresolved-name import to Any AND stops meaningfully checking the annotations that use it, so those three modules were effectively unchecked. Adding the two re-exports retired 6 [attr-defined] and UNMASKED 16 pre-existing real type errors in orm/fields/relational/ -- overwhelmingly str|None passed where str is required in the many2many table/column/FK-creation path (add_foreign_key, SQL.identifier, table_exists), plus OrderedSet-vs-tuple confusion in _base.py's protected-set handling. Those 16 are latent None-safety debt now VISIBLE for the first time; several look like genuine missing None-guards on column1/column2/relation. They should be driven down, not parked here. odoo/orm/tests/test_typing_reexports.py AST-asserts that every 'from ..._typing import X' across orm/ resolves, so this class cannot recur silently. See odoo-core-architecture-audit.md finding F1.2.

(2) THE NEW ROOT PACKAGE RETIRED 5 MORE. odoo/__init__.py + __init__.pyi replace the import-side-effect assignment of SUPERUSER_ID/_/_lt/Command onto the namespace package. That retires 4 'Module has no attribute "evented"' (service/lifecycle.py x3, http/request_class.py) and 1 'Module "odoo" has no attribute "Command"'. The .pyi is load-bearing and not optional: a module with __getattr__ makes mypy accept EVERY attribute, which would have hidden exactly those 5 rather than fixing them.
